# Support

Thanks for using this Neorgon tool. Here is how to get help.

## Questions & Usage Help

- Check the project [`README.md`](../README.md) first — it covers setup,
  local development, and common commands.
- Browse existing [issues](../../issues) to see if your question is already answered.

## Reporting Bugs

Open a [bug report](../../issues/new?template=bug_report.md) with reproduction
steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and your browser/OS.

## Requesting Features

Open a [feature request](../../issues/new?template=feature_request.md) describing
the problem you are trying to solve.

## Security Issues

Do **not** file public issues for security problems. See [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).
